title: Etale modules on a field and discrete Galois modules
statement:
Let $K$ be a field, fix $K^{\rm sep}$, put
$G=\operatorname{Gal}(K^{\rm sep}/K)$, and let $A$ be
a finite commutative ring. The geometric fibre functor
identifies etale
$A$-module sheaves on $\operatorname{Spec}K$ with
discrete continuous
$A[G]$-modules, as exact abelian categories with their
section functors. Sections correspond to invariants.

proof.text: The finite etale objects and their covering families are described by the G-set equivalence [lem-exc-etale-field-gsets]. Its abelian enhancement says that taking the geometric stalk at $\operatorname{Spec}K^{\rm sep}$, as defined in [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], is an equivalence between abelian sheaves on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and discrete $G$-modules, by [lem-exc-abelian-sheaves-gmodules]. Thus the geometric fibre of an etale abelian sheaf is the corresponding discrete $G$-module.

An $A$-module sheaf is an abelian sheaf together with a ring map $A\to\operatorname{End}(F)$. The additive, fully faithful equivalence [lem-exc-abelian-sheaves-gmodules] transports this structure to a ring map $A\to\operatorname{End}_G(M)$ and hence to a discrete continuous $A[G]$-module in the sense of [def-exc-continuous-cohomology]; the inverse construction transports it back.

For a finite separable extension $L/K$, let $H=\operatorname{Gal}(K^{\rm sep}/L)$. By the Yoneda lemma, $F(\operatorname{Spec}L)=\operatorname{Hom}(h_{\operatorname{Spec}L},F)$, naturally in $L$, where $h_{\operatorname{Spec}L}$ is the sheaf of sets represented by $\operatorname{Spec}L$. By [lem-exc-etale-sheaves-gsets-point], taking geometric stalks is an equivalence from sheaves of sets on $(\operatorname{Spec}K)_{\rm et}$ to discrete $G$-sets, and the stalk of $h_{\operatorname{Spec}L}$ is the $G$-set $\operatorname{Hom}_K(\operatorname{Spec}K^{\rm sep},\operatorname{Spec}L)$, which is the $G$-set attached to $\operatorname{Spec}L$ by [lem-exc-etale-field-gsets]; it is the set of $K$-embeddings $L\to K^{\rm sep}$, transitive with stabilizer $H$ of the given inclusion, i.e. $G/H$. The underlying $G$-set of the stalk of $F$ is $M$ ([lem-exc-abelian-sheaves-gmodules] is compatible with the sheaf-of-sets/$G$-set equivalence). Full faithfulness therefore identifies sections with equivariant maps $G/H\to M$, and evaluation at the identity coset identifies these maps with $M^H$. Hence $F(\operatorname{Spec}L)=M^{\operatorname{Gal}(K^{\rm sep}/L)}$, compatibly with restriction maps (naturality in $L$).

The equivalence [lem-exc-abelian-sheaves-gmodules] is an equivalence of abelian categories; the target abelian structure and enough injectives are supplied by [lem-exc-discrete-modules-abelian]. Therefore it is exact, and its section formula at $L=K$ is $F(\operatorname{Spec}K)=M^G$ by the preceding G-set calculation. The right derived section functors consequently agree with continuous cohomology [def-exc-continuous-cohomology], because an exact equivalence transports injective resolutions. The stalk functor itself is exact as recorded in [prop-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks-exact].

lean.statement: theorem etaleModuleSheaves_equiv_discreteGModules (K Ks : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Algebra K Ks] [IsSepClosure K Ks] (A : Type v) [CommRing A] [Finite A] : let S := Spec (.of K) let J := S.smallEtaleTopology let s := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ks)) let p := pointSmallEtale s let G := Gal(Ks/K) let D := Rep.DiscreteContinuousRep.{v, u, max (u + 1) v} A G let U : D ⥤ Rep.{max (u + 1) v} A G := ObjectProperty.ι _ ∃ (E : Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} A) ≌ D) (i : E.functor ⋙ U ⋙ Rep.RepToAction A G ⋙ Action.forget (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} A) G ≅ p.sheafFiber) (_σ : (sheafSections J (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} A)).obj (op (Etale.mk (𝟙 S))) ≅ E.functor ⋙ U ⋙ Rep.invariantsFunctor A G), ∀ (F : Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} A)) (g : G) (X : S.Etale) (x x' : p.fiber.obj X) (_hx : x'.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g.toRingHom) ≫ x.left) (z : F.obj.obj (op X)), (i.hom.app F) ((E.functor.obj F).obj.ρ g ((i.inv.app F) (p.toPresheafFiber X x F.obj z))) = p.toPresheafFiber X x' F.obj z
